item.title: CII proposes 15 financial sector reforms to support India's $26.5 trillion economy target
item.description: The Confederation of Indian Industry has recommended reforms to improve India's financial system for future growth. These proposals include enhancing liquidity for non-banking financial companies and revising priority sector lending norms. The aim is to address the significant gap in financial assets needed for a $26.5 trillion economy by 2047. The CII emphasizes the importance of deep institutional investments in corporate bonds to support this growth.

item.title: CII proposes 15 financial sector reforms to support India's $26.5 trillion economy target
item.description: CII has proposed 15 reforms across banking, NBFCs, capital markets, insurance and fintech to strengthen India’s financial system for long-term growth, including a permanent liquidity facility for NBFCs, wider investment in lower-rated corporate bonds and a national catastrophe risk pool. It estimates that a $26.5 trillion economy by 2047 would require about $106 trillion in financial assets, with banks, bond markets and MSME credit needing significant expansion.

item.title: India Inc earnings outlook remains upbeat for second half of FY27 on broad-based demand: Report
item.description: Corporate earnings are expected to remain strong in the second half of FY27, supported by healthy demand, business expansion and robust order pipelines, Motilal Oswal Financial Services said. The brokerage cited broad-based earnings growth in the September quarter, led by banking, financial services, metals, oil and gas, and automobiles, while flagging cost pressures and geopolitical risks.

item.title: Noel seeks Tata Sons board meet recordings, objects to Venu voting on Chandra' s reappointment
item.description: Noel Tata requested recordings from a recent Tata Sons board meeting concerning N Chandrasekaran's reappointment decisions. His letter asserted his rights as a board member regarding the nomination and remuneration committee discussions. Venu Srinivasan, a director, was called out for potential conflict of interest related to his business dealings. Tata Sons previously denied the existence of conflict and refused to provide the recordings.

item.title: HCL's Shiv Nadar most generous Indian; Adani doubles donations, Ambani's support down 1%: Report
item.description: In 2026, Shiv Nadar and family topped the philanthropy list in India with donations totaling Rs 2,593 crore. Gautam Adani and family significantly increased their contributions to Rs 877 crore, ranking second. The Bajaj family held third place with a 42 percent rise, donating Rs 632 crore. Donations to education dominated the charitable causes, capturing Rs 4,188 crore out of the total contributions.

item.title: Over Rs 250 cr grants cleared by Tata Trusts before next week's crucial Tata Sons board meet
item.description: Trustees of Tata Trusts approved over Rs 250 crore in grants for various social upliftment projects. Key decisions included a Rs 50 crore grant for Jehangir Hospital's expansion, which raised some questions. The grants also targeted initiatives such as sports academies, poverty alleviation, and support for girl children. Chairman Noel Tata presided over the meetings at the trusts' South Mumbai office.

item.title: Tata Sons largest shareholder meets to discuss listing amid internal rift
item.description: Tata Group's governance dispute emerges as its shareholders prepare for crucial meetings in the coming weeks. Discussions will focus on the potential public listing of Tata Sons and control over the conglomerate. Tata Trusts leadership has faced challenges as internal disagreements intensify regarding the group's future. The upcoming meetings aim to clarify differing perspectives while assessing regulatory compliance requirements.

item.title: Nvidia's fallout is a gift to billionaires Ambani and Adani
item.description: Mukesh Ambani and Gautam Adani could emerge as major winners from Washington’s crackdown on Southeast Asian data centres following the Nvidia controversy. As the US tightens restrictions on advanced AI chips over concerns about Chinese access, India’s growing data-centre ambitions and massive investments by Reliance Industries and Adani Group could attract global technology giants seeking secure AI infrastructure.

item.title: Subhash Chandra Insolvency Case: CBI gets 3 weeks to reply
item.description: The National Company Law Tribunal has directed the CBI to file its response regarding Subhash Chandra's personal insolvency case. A special five-member bench requested all parties to create a single compilation of relevant documents. The tribunal granted three weeks for this compilation and the CBI's response to be submitted. Additionally, the CBI must ensure that its counsel participates in the proceedings.

item.title: Adani CFO pushes back on Uday Kotak's comparison of Anthropic with India's top companies
item.description: Kotak, Founder and Director of Kotak Mahindra Bank, had pointed to the valuation reached by Anthropic, the maker of AI chatbot Claude, about five years after its founding. "Are we undervalued, or do we need to catch up in the new world? Or both?" he asked in a post on X. Singh called the comparison "a textbook category error in asset pricing" in his reply.

item.title: India can replicate pharma, IT success in emerging sectors to boost exports: Economist
item.description: Naina Lal Kidwai highlighted India's ability to expand its export successes in emerging industries like electronics and defense. She emphasized the need for quality manufacturing that caters to both domestic and international markets. According to her, India should focus on import substitution to strengthen its industrial ecosystem. Kidwai also mentioned the impact of global crude prices on inflation within the Indian economy.

item.title: India's wedding season set to generate Rs 7.5 lakh crore business from 52 lakh weddings: CAIT
item.description: India's upcoming wedding season is expected to generate substantial business worth Rs 7.5 lakh crore. The estimate includes both goods and services sold during 52 lakh weddings scheduled from November 21 to December 15, 2026. Additionally, it is projected that approximately 1.25 crore temporary jobs will be created, boosting economic activity. Key sectors involved include retail, hospitality, and event management, which will benefit significantly from this surge.

item.title: TVS Family Feud: What's Happening Within the Srinivasan Family?
Tata Tech eyes doubling revenue to $1.3 bn by 2030
item.description: Tata Technologies intends to grow its revenue to USD 1.1-1.3 billion by 2030. The company predicts a compound annual growth rate of 15-20 percent until then. Key sectors for expansion include full-vehicle projects, aerospace, and industrial heavy machinery. The aerospace segment is expected to be the fastest-growing division of the business.

item.title: Blackstone stake buy to support IIFL Finance's capital needs: Fitch Ratings
item.description: Blackstone has announced its intention to acquire a 16 percent stake in IIFL Finance, which will aid capital growth. IIFL's board has approved a plan to raise Rs 6,414 crore, including investments from Blackstone and its promoters. This investment is expected to strengthen IIFL's regulatory Tier 1 ratio, supporting its growth strategy. The capital will help improve technology and reduce reliance on volatile funding sources.

item.title: Darius Khambata hits back at Venu Srinivasan, Vijay Singh; says control of Tata Sons by Trusts essence of Tata model
item.description: Control of Tata Sons by Tata Trusts, a set of non-profits which collectively own two-thirds of the largest conglomerate's holding company, is the essence of the 'Tata model', Khambata, a senior lawyer, said in a four-page letter written to Srinivasan and Singh.

item.title: Only 23% of India's employees are engaged at work: Why organisations need to rethink workplace culture
item.description: Employee engagement in India remains low, with only 23% of workers feeling engaged, highlighting the need for organizations to focus on genuine employee experience rather than superficial perks. Leadership significantly impacts workplace culture, and recognizing effective people practices is crucial for transformation, as seen in the ET HR Excellence Awards 2027.

item.title: AI adoption, weak demand to keep India's IT services revenue growth subdued in FY27: Report
item.description: India's IT services sector is expected to experience subdued revenue growth in the near term. The rising adoption of artificial intelligence is shifting technology spending towards AI-focused companies. Revenue growth in traditional services continues to decline, leading to lower growth guidance from large IT firms. Profit margins for major IT companies are under pressure due to increased investments and competitive pricing.

item.title: 5 signs your product is ready to earn industry recognition and stand out in the market
item.description: The ET Product of the Year Awards 2026 highlights the importance of measurable impact in product development. Businesses are encouraged to submit nominations that showcase customer adoption, real problem-solving, visible innovation, proven execution, and independent benchmarking. Nominations close on 30 November 2026.

item.title: 5 reasons why the ET HR Excellence Awards 2027 are made for your organisation
item.description: Nominate your organization for the ET HR Excellence Awards 2027 if you have implemented impactful HR initiatives. With 40+ award categories focused on HR transformation, employee experience, talent acquisition, and leadership, this is an opportunity to showcase your achievements and gain industry recognition. Nominations are open until December 31, 2026.

item.title: Who signs on Monday?
item.description: Key personnel risk is the succession question family businesses refuse to ask. Investors are paying for the silence.

item.title: Govt opens registration for consent managers under DPDP Act; Rs 2 crore net worth required
item.description: The government has launched the registration process for consent managers under the Digital Personal Data Protection Act. Eligible companies with a minimum net worth of Rs 2 crore can apply online. The Data Protection Board of India will review applications based on set criteria. Registered consent managers will allow individuals to manage their personal data effectively. Further phases of data protection implementation are scheduled for upcoming dates.

item.title: Ola fined Rs 10 lakh for seeking extra payments before rides are confirmed
item.description: The Central Consumer Protection Authority has penalized ANI Technologies for its misleading payment practices on Ola. The regulator noted that soliciting add-on payments misleads consumers and constitutes an unfair trade practice. This feature suggested that paying extra could expedite ride allocation, despite evidence depicting the opposite. Ola has been ordered to cease this practice immediately and ensure compliance with consumer protection laws.

item.title: Redefining professional services: How innovative delivery models are solving complex business challenges
item.description: The ET Business & Professional Services Innovation of the Year category highlights innovative services that effectively address specific organizational needs, focusing on measurable value creation. Eligible companies must demonstrate client adoption, repeat business, and exemplary execution while showcasing how their unique service delivery models differentiate them in the market.

item.title: Moving from CSR to workplace culture: Why responsible HR is the new benchmark for top organizations
item.description: The ET HR Excellence Awards 2027 feature the Excellence in Responsible & Purpose-Driven HR category, celebrating businesses that harness HR for positive social and environmental change. This award recognizes efforts in areas like employee volunteering, sustainable initiatives, and community involvement. It underscores the significance of weaving purpose into the workplace experience while demonstrating tangible results.

item.title: 'What we have done is not enough', says Lenskart CEO as he eyes 10 cr eyewear units a year
item.description: Lenskart co-founder Peyush Bansal announced plans to increase production from 3.2 crore to 10 crore eyewear units. The company will provide blue-light lenses at no extra cost, enhancing accessibility for customers. On November 14, Lenskart plans to offer prescription glasses to one lakh children for a nominal charge. These initiatives reflect a commitment to improving vision and making it more affordable for all.

item.title: 5 reasons why your product should be nominated for the ET Product of the Year Awards 2026
item.description: India's product landscape is rapidly transforming, driven by innovative solutions and upgraded offerings that cater to consumer demands. The ET Product of the Year Awards 2026 aims to shine a spotlight on products that have significantly impacted the market, emphasizing their success, user adoption, and overall customer value. Businesses are invited to submit nominations for products that debuted or evolved during the designated period to celebrate their accomplishments.

item.title: 7 reasons why organisations & HR leaders should nominate for the ET HR Excellence Awards 2027
item.description: The ET HR Excellence Awards 2027 celebrate the transformative efforts of organizations and HR leaders making a significant impact in workplace culture. These prestigious awards shine a light on initiatives that enrich employee experiences and show real business results. Now is the time to submit nominations and share your stories of success in the dynamic world of HR.

item.title: India blocked 129 betting websites on basis of fake high court orders: Report
item.description: India's government ordered internet providers to block 129 betting websites based on fraudulent high court orders. Investigations have been initiated after it was revealed that these court orders were fake. The Rajasthan and Allahabad High Courts confirmed that the supposed orders did not exist in their records. Concerns about the authenticity of legal documents are growing due to technology advancements.

item.title: UK-based Tide to invest 250 million pounds in India in next four years
item.description: Tide, a UK-based financial platform, will invest 250 million pounds in India by 2030 to enhance operations. The investment focuses on technology centers supporting global business, particularly in the UK and Europe. Tide's significant presence in India includes approximately 800 employees, although it will exit the member-facing business, affecting around 400 employees. The decision follows a strategic review indicating profitability challenges in the Indian market.

item.title: Adani Group to invest more than $120 billion in capex over five years: Report
item.description: The Adani Group is poised to infuse over $120 billion into capital projects within the next five years, predominantly channeling funds into the energy sector, transport, and logistics. With about 70% allocated to energy, and 20% to transport and logistics, this substantial investment aims to double the group's asset base and generate core earnings ranging from 2.6 to 3 trillion rupees.

item.title: Is your HR strategy creating measurable impact? This could be the time to get it recognised
item.description: The Economic Times HR Excellence Awards 2027 shine a light on exemplary HR practices within various organizations, teams, and leaders. Encompassing 42 categories, the awards highlight significant accomplishments in realms like HR transformation, talent acquisition, employee experience, and workplace culture, showcasing how effective people strategies can directly enhance business performance.

item.title: Tata Projects subsidiary CEO Shashank Shekhar Jha tenders resignation
item.description: Shashank Shekhar Jha resigned from his position as CEO of Artson Engineering to explore new career opportunities. He reflected on his four-year leadership as one of the most rewarding experiences of his career. Jha expressed gratitude to his team and assured a smooth transition during the notice period. Artson Engineering Ltd experienced a drop in share price following the announcement of his resignation.

item.title: India’s product landscape is changing: Which products are setting the benchmark across technology, finance, and consumer markets?
item.description: The ET Product of the Year Awards 2026 showcase India's rapidly growing product ecosystem by honoring groundbreaking innovations across diverse sectors such as enterprise technology, financial services, and consumer markets. These awards place emphasis on products that have made a significant market impact, gained customer adoption, and demonstrated exceptional innovation, motivating companies to present their tangible successes and contributions to the industry.

item.title: Need for rules comes to fore as India corporate landscape clutters up with family feuds
item.description: India's corporate landscape is witnessing a surge in family disputes that threaten the very foundation of long-established businesses. Following the exit or passing of key patriarchs, internal discord often erupts, underscoring the critical requirement for legislative mechanisms that favour transparent succession planning.

item.title: In Noel's crosshairs, Chandra and Mehli reconnect at Tata HQ
item.description: Tata Sons chairman N Chandrasekaran met Mehli Mistry at Bombay House last week in a move aimed at rebuilding trust after more than a year of strained relations. The two discussed issues that affected their equation following Mistry's removal from two key Tata trusts, a challenge that remains pending before the Maharashtra Charity Commissioner.

item.title: 56% of global business leaders expect disruptions to severely hit operations: KPMG
item.description: A recent KPMG International report indicates that 56 percent of global business leaders anticipate severe disruptions affecting operations. The report highlights increasing risk exposure, with 70 percent of leaders noting escalated risks in recent years. Technology disruption and geopolitical tensions are identified as primary concerns for the near future. Companies are prioritizing AI and predictive analytics to enhance supply chain resilience and managing risks.

item.title: Adani Enterprises plans Rs 35,000-40,000 crore annual capex in next two years
item.description: Adani Enterprises intends to invest between Rs 35,000 crore and Rs 40,000 crore annually for upcoming years. The major areas of focus will be airports, data centres, and a PVC manufacturing complex. Recently, the company reported strong financial growth, with a notable increase in EBITDA and revenue. This investment cycle aims to enhance operational capabilities and generate returns from new assets.

item.title: AI slump revives Asia’s forgotten trades from China to India
item.description: Global investors are rethinking their Asia bets as the AI trade loses momentum following the US midterm elections. India and China are emerging as potential beneficiaries of the shift, with funds rotating towards undervalued stocks, domestic growth, healthcare, consumer companies and financials. India's limited AI exposure, easing oil prices and renewed foreign inflows are strengthening its appeal.

item.title: AvenuesAI Q2 revenue jumps 47% as AI-first fintech transformation gathers momentum
item.description: AvenuesAI reported a steady set of second-quarter FY27 numbers, with the company continuing to build momentum behind its broader transformation from a payments gateway-led business into an AI-first financial technology infrastructure platform.

item.title: Mehli Mistry challenges removal as Tata Trusts trustee, seeks independent inquiry into governance
item.description: Mehli Mistry has filed a challenge against his removal as a trustee of the Sir Dorabji Tata Trust. He has raised concerns about procedural irregularities and trustee eligibility in his case. Mistry also seeks an independent inquiry into financial matters related to the trust's administration. He has claimed conflicts of interest and improper financial benefits received by some trustees.

item.title: eMudhra says TLS certificate security incident impacted 1% of revenue
item.description: eMudhra Ltd experienced a certificate security incident in October that impacted its TLS business revenue significantly. Following the incident, the company revoked the affected intermediary certificates to prevent further issues. Executive Chairman V. Srinivasan confirmed that no end-entity certificates were issued, maintaining the integrity of the infrastructure. KPMG was appointed as an independent external reviewer to investigate the incident thoroughly.

item.title: CCI clears KKR's Rs 6,000 crore investment in PETRONAS-backed Gentari Renewables
item.description: Global investment firm KKR has received approval from India's Competition Commission to invest in Gentari Renewables India. This clean energy platform is part of Malaysia's PETRONAS group, which focuses on renewable energy projects. KKR plans to invest approximately Rs 6,000 crore in the Indian renewable energy sector. The firm already holds investments in various Indian clean energy companies.

item.title: S&P affirms Reliance Industries' 'A-' credit rating, cites Jio listing, stronger earnings
item.description: S&P Global Ratings has affirmed Reliance Industries’ (RIL) ‘A-’ long-term issuer credit rating with a stable outlook, citing resilient earnings, strong cash generation and improved funding flexibility following the listing of Jio Platforms.

item.title: India Inc’s boardroom report makes for grim reading
item.description: Women currently hold one in five seats on Nifty 100 company boards, remaining unchanged over the past four years. Younger independent directors under the age of 50 have decreased in number on these boards. A report reveals that 17 companies, primarily state-run, lack the required number of independent directors.

item.title: Personalised festive experiences key to brand loyalty for 72% of Indian shoppers: Survey
item.description: A recent survey indicates that 72 percent of Indian holiday shoppers prefer brands that provide personalized experiences. Consumers are increasingly seeking brands that demonstrate understanding of their preferences and offer seamless engagement. The survey found that 68 percent of respondents favor brands with an omnichannel presence for better communication. Additionally, shoppers are concerned about data security, which influences their loyalty just like festive offers.

item.title: As HR takes on a larger business role, are organisations recognising the teams driving that change?
item.description: The Economic Times HR Excellence Awards 2027 spotlight the transformative nature of HR within organizations, underlining their crucial role in shaping business strategy, fostering talent development, and enhancing employee experiences. With six distinct award categories such as Talent Acquisition and Employee Experience, this initiative serves to honor HR teams that significantly boost organizational performance and drive workforce change.

item.title: Sudarshan Venu family trusts pledge TVS shares to fund TSF stake buy
item.description: Sudarshan Venu's trusts have secured ₹825 crore through share pledges to acquire an additional stake in TVS Holdings. The acquisition will raise Sudarshan's stake to 73.35%, enhancing family ownership. Funds from JM Financial Products and JM Financial Credit Solutions will finance this transaction. TVS Holdings reported a 39% increase in consolidated revenue, demonstrating strong business performance. This realignment of ownership reflects Sudarshan's growing role in the group’s future direction.

item.title: Finance Minister Sitharaman urges Tata to resolve feud amicably, rules out govt intervention
item.description: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman emphasized the importance of resolving the ongoing dispute between Tata Sons and Tata Trusts. She stated that the matter should remain private to restore normalcy quickly. Sitharaman highlighted the critical nature of this situation for the Indian economy, particularly amidst foreign capital outflows. Concerns regarding the equity market and foreign investments were also acknowledged by the finance minister.
